title: A Founder’s Guide to Meta Advantage Plus Shopping Campaigns

facts.fact: The guide says Meta claims Advantage+ Shopping Campaigns delivered a 17% lower cost per conversion on average compared to manual campaigns.
facts.quote: Meta claims that Advantage+ Shopping Campaigns delivered a **17% lower cost per conversion** on average compared to manual campaigns.

facts.fact: The guide quotes Meta for Business as saying that for every $1 spent on Advantage+ shopping campaigns, advertisers saw 17% more purchases than advertisers using manual shopping campaigns.
facts.quote: "For every $1 advertisers spent using Advantage+ shopping campaigns, they saw 17% more purchases compared to advertisers who used manual shopping campaigns."

facts.fact: The guide was created on February 10, 2026 and last updated on the same date.
